config.scope: User-authorized labelled-only diagnostics before considering additional full-pool extraction. Conditional saved-OOF selection, not fully nested base-model refits. No deployment rate or upload supported. Multiple trunks mean multiple readouts of the same frozen trunk extraction, not new Boltz runs.

error_definition: Residual and squared loss of within-fold ranks versus binary labels; not calibrated-probability residuals. Raw Brier scores descriptive only.
uncertainty: Paired UMAP-group bootstrap conditional on saved scores and selected calls; no reranking or selector refit in bootstrap; no multiplicity correction.
limitations: Labelled-only operating pool; conditional saved-OOF selection, not fully nested base-model fitting. Multiple views reuse the same frozen trunk. No submission or deployment rate.
